survey: A carved jack-o'-lantern on a wooden tabletop, against a purple sunburst background. The camera is a little above the pumpkin and looks slightly down. Tabletop: the planks run left to right across the frame. Their seams are close to horizontal, and the gaps between them widen toward the viewer, which fits a surface seen from slightly above. The table's far edge sits behind the upper third of the pumpkin, which fits that camera height. Pumpkin body: a squat, rounded shape whose top is visible as a gentle curve. The vertical ribs bend around the form and bunch together toward the left and right edges as the surface turns away. Stem: it rises from the centre of the top, and its cut end shows as a narrow ellipse seen from above, the same view as the body. Carved face: the two triangular eyes and the zigzag mouth sit on the front of the body. The mouth follows the curve of the body slightly. Each cut shows its inner wall along the lower edge, which is what you would see looking down into a hole in an upright surface. Contact: the bottom of the pumpkin flattens onto the planks, and a soft shadow falls to the right on the table, so it sits flat on the tabletop at the angle the table is drawn.
